definitions.W1: Semantic answer selected on the original first-presentation Baseline.
definitions.W2: Semantic answer selected by a fresh Baseline under the remapped second presentation.
definitions.residual_trajectory: Other-condition complete post-block residual at the action-closing period, clamped at all 64 blocks.
definitions.gla_state: Other-condition accumulated recurrent matrix state immediately after the action-closing period in all 48 GLAs.
definitions.signed_transfer: Movement from the recipient condition toward the donor condition. Positive is successful causal transfer.
